title: MutationOp
description: One normalized operation of a proposed metadata change, recorded with the published value it was computed against.

mutationOpType.description: set replaces a top-level field value; add and remove change one element of a list field identified by key.

key.description: Element identity for add/remove: entity reference id, tag FQN, or the string value itself.

baseValue.description: JSON of the published field value this op was computed against. Set ops only.

value.description: JSON of the proposed field value (set) or of the element being added/removed.

gated.description: True when an approval workflow gates this field; false for a field carried along in a staged request.
